duas.so: Aayatul Kursi: Alle mooyee ilaah kale ma jiro; waa Noolaha wax walba maamula.
duas.en: Ayat al-Kursi: there is no god but Allah, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer.

duas.so: Suuratul Ikhlaas: Alle waa Kelidiis, wax la mid ahna ma jiro.
duas.en: Al-Ikhlas: Allah is One, and nothing is comparable to Him.

duas.so: Suuratul Falaq: magangal sharka abuurka, sixirka iyo xaasidka.
duas.en: Al-Falaq: seeking refuge from the evil of creation, sorcery and envy.

duas.so: Suuratun Naas: magangal sharka waswaaska jinka iyo dadka.
duas.en: An-Nas: seeking refuge from the whisperer among jinn and people.

duas.so: Rabbiyow adduunka iyo aakhiraba wanaag na sii, naartana naga ilaali.
duas.en: Our Lord, give us good in this world and the next, and protect us from the Fire.

duas.so: Rabbiyow quluubteenna ha leexin markaad na hanuunisay ka dib.
duas.en: Our Lord, do not let our hearts deviate after You have guided us.

duas.so: Ducadii Ibraahim iyo Ismaaciil: Rabbiyow naga aqbal.
duas.en: Prayer of Ibrahim and Ismail: Our Lord, accept this from us.

duas.so: Rabbiyow naga yeel kuwo kuu hoggaansan, faracayagana ummad kuu hoggaansan.
duas.en: Our Lord, make us and our descendants submit to You.

duas.so: Rabbiyow samir nagu shub, cagahayagana suj.
duas.en: Our Lord, pour patience upon us and make our feet firm.

duas.so: Rabbiyow ha nagu qabsan wixii aan illownay ama ku gefnay; noo dambi dhaaf.
duas.en: Our Lord, do not blame us if we forget or err; pardon and forgive us.

duas.so: Rabbiyow waan rumaynay, ee noo dambi dhaaf, naartana naga ilaali.
duas.en: Our Lord, we have believed, so forgive us and protect us from the Fire.

duas.so: Rabbiyow dambiyadayada iyo xad-gudubkayaga noo dhaaf, cagahayagana suj.
duas.en: Our Lord, forgive our sins and excesses and make our feet firm.

duas.so: Alle ayaa nagu filan, isagaana ah Wakiilka ugu wanaagsan.
duas.en: Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the best Disposer of affairs.

duas.so: Ducadii Aadam iyo Xaawo: Rabbiyow naftayada ayaan dulminnay; haddaadan noo dambi dhaafin waan khasaarnaynaa.
duas.en: Prayer of Adam and Hawwa: Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves.

duas.so: Rabbiyow iga yeel mid salaadda ooga, faracaygana sidoo kale.
duas.en: My Lord, make me one who establishes prayer, and my descendants too.

duas.so: Rabbiyow ii dambi dhaaf, labadayda waalid iyo mu’miniinta.
duas.en: Our Lord, forgive me, my parents and the believers.

duas.so: Rabbiyow u naxariiso labadayda waalid sidii ay ii soo barbaariyeen.
duas.en: My Lord, have mercy on my parents as they raised me when I was small.

duas.so: Rabbiyow gelid run ah igu geli, bixid run ahna iga bixi.
duas.en: My Lord, grant me a truthful entrance and a truthful exit.

duas.so: Rabbiyow naxariis xaggaaga ah na sii, arrinkayagana toosnaan noo diyaari.
duas.en: Our Lord, grant us mercy from Yourself and guide our affair.

duas.so: Ducadii Muuse: Rabbiyow laabta ii waasici, arrinkaygana ii fududee.
duas.en: Prayer of Musa: My Lord, expand my chest and ease my task.

duas.so: Rabbiyow cilmi ii kordhi.
duas.en: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.

duas.so: Ducadii Ayyuub: waxaa i taabtay dhib, adigaana ugu naxariista badan.
duas.en: Prayer of Ayyub: harm has touched me, and You are the Most Merciful.

duas.so: Ducadii Yuunus: Adiga mooyee ilaah kale ma jiro; waad nasahan tahay.
duas.en: Prayer of Yunus: there is no god but You; glory be to You.

duas.so: Ducadii Zakariye: Rabbiyow keli ha iga tegin.
duas.en: Prayer of Zakariyya: My Lord, do not leave me alone.

duas.so: Rabbiyow i dejiya meel barakaysan.
duas.en: My Lord, let me land at a blessed landing place.

duas.so: Rabbiyow waxaan kaa magan galayaa waswaaska shaydaannada.
duas.en: My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the promptings of the devils.

duas.so: Rabbiyow xaasaskayaga iyo faracayaga nooga dhig qurrada indhaha.
duas.en: Our Lord, grant us joy in our spouses and children.

duas.so: Ducadii Sulaymaan: Rabbiyow i waafaji inaan kaaga mahadceliyo nimcadaada.
duas.en: Prayer of Sulayman: My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favour.

duas.so: Rabbiyow naftayda ayaan dulmiyay, ee ii dambi dhaaf.
duas.en: My Lord, I have wronged myself, so forgive me.

duas.so: Rabbiyow waxaan u baahanahay wixii khayr ah ee aad ii soo dejiso.
duas.en: My Lord, I am in need of whatever good You send down to me.

duas.so: Rabbiyow i sii farac ka mid ah kuwa suubban.
duas.en: My Lord, grant me a righteous child.

duas.so: Ducada gaadiid fuulidda: Waxaa hufan Kan noo sakhiray tan.
duas.en: On riding a vehicle: Glory to Him who has subjected this to us.

duas.so: Rabbiyow i waafaji mahadnaqa, camal wanaagsan, faraceygana ii hagaaji.
duas.en: My Lord, enable me to be grateful, to do good, and make my offspring righteous.

duas.so: Rabbiyow noo dambi dhaaf annaga iyo walaalaheen iimaanka nooga horreeyay.
duas.en: Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith.

duas.so: Ducadii Nuux: Rabbiyow ii dambi dhaaf, waalidkay iyo mu’miniinta.
duas.en: Prayer of Nuh: My Lord, forgive me, my parents and the believers.
